card.name: Inside long medical terms
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the piece of a long medical or scientific word just before the word is finished. The clearest case is the "in" ending of "thromboplastin" in "activated partial thromboplastin time".

modes.label: Thromboplastin in aPTT
modes.description: The "in" ending of thromboplastin in the name of the clotting test aPTT.
